items.name: Casing Joint (Threaded)
items.brief_description: Parametrized hollow cylindrical pipe section with threaded box/pin ends — defined by OD, wall thickness, ID, drift diameter, joint length, and connection geometry (connection OD, length, threads-per-inch).

items.name: Tubing Joint (Threaded)
items.brief_description: Smaller-diameter parametrized hollow cylinder (1.9"–4.5" OD) with threaded ends for production strings — parametrized by OD, wall, ID, drift, R-2 range joint length, and connection (EUE/premium) geometry.

items.name: Casing Joint
items.brief_description: Long thick-walled hollow cylinder with threaded ends, parametrized by OD, wall thickness, joint length (R-3 range) and connection type.

items.name: Tubing Joint
items.brief_description: Smaller-OD hollow cylinder for production flow, parametrized by OD, wall thickness, joint length (R-2 range) and connection type.

items.name: Liner Pipe (LP)
items.brief_description: Large-OD thin-wall hollow cylinder used as conductor or surface liner, parametrized identically to casing but with shorter typical joint length.

items.name: Plain-End Pipe
items.brief_description: Hollow cylinder with square-cut, unthreaded ends ready for field welding; parametrized by OD, ID, and length.

items.name: Threaded Coupling (Collar)
items.brief_description: Short thick-walled sleeve with internal threads on both ends used to join two pipe pin ends; parametrized by coupling OD, length, and thread form.

items.name: Pin-End Thread
items.brief_description: External tapered male thread region on a pipe end; parametrized by taper, thread per inch, and length.

items.name: Box-End Thread
items.brief_description: Internal tapered female thread inside a coupling or upset; parametrized by taper, thread per inch, and depth.

items.name: Buttress Thread (BC)
items.brief_description: Asymmetric square-flanked helical thread profile on a tapered surface; parametrized by pitch, load-flank angle, and taper.

items.name: API Round Thread (LC/SC)
items.brief_description: V-shaped round-crest helical thread profile on a tapered cylinder; parametrized by pitch, taper, and engagement length (short vs long).

items.name: Premium Metal-to-Metal Connection
items.brief_description: Pin/box geometry combining a hooked thread, internal torque shoulder, and conical metal-to-metal seal (VAM TOP, XLC-S, Tenaris Blue); parametrized by seal angle and shoulder offset.

items.name: External Upset End (EUE)
items.brief_description: Pipe end with an external thickening cone transitioning to a larger threaded boss; parametrized by upset OD, transition length, and thread length.

items.name: Non-Upset End (NUE)
items.brief_description: Pipe end with no external thickening — threads cut directly into the body; parametrized by thread length and pipe OD.

items.name: Integral Flush Joint
items.brief_description: Couplingless connection where the box is machined into a slightly upset pipe end so the joint OD equals the pipe OD; parametrized by upset rise and thread length.

items.name: Slip Joint
items.brief_description: Two telescoping cylinders that slide axially to accommodate thermal expansion; parametrized by stroke length, seal-bore length, and OD.

items.name: Drift Mandrel
items.brief_description: Solid cylinder used as an ID gauge to verify a pipe's drift diameter along its length; parametrized by drift OD and gauge length.

items.name: Color Identification Band
items.brief_description: Thin painted ring (1–3 bands) wrapped around a pipe body to encode grade/connection; parametrized by band width, axial offset, and stripe count.

items.name: Thread Taper Cone
items.brief_description: Underlying truncated cone on which API or premium threads are cut; parametrized by taper ratio (typ. 1:16 or 1:6), length, and base OD.

items.name: Conductor Casing Joint
items.brief_description: Large-OD short thick-wall pipe section (drive pipe / marine conductor) set first below the structural casing to protect near-surface formations.

items.name: Surface Casing Joint
items.brief_description: Intermediate-OD cylindrical pipe joint cemented to surface to provide blowout protection and isolate shallow water sands.

items.name: Intermediate Casing Joint
items.brief_description: Mid-string cylindrical casing pipe used to isolate unstable hole, lost-circulation, low-pressure or production zones between surface and production casing.

items.name: Production Casing Joint
items.brief_description: Smaller-OD casing pipe run across the pay zone to contain production pressures and isolate the formation around the tubing.

items.name: Liner Joint
items.brief_description: Casing-style pipe joint that does not return to surface, hung from a parent casing string via a liner hanger at its top.

items.name: Liner Tieback Joint
items.brief_description: Cylindrical casing joint that ties an installed liner top back to the wellhead for full-length pressure integrity.

items.name: Plain-End Pipe Body
items.brief_description: Generic hollow cylinder of length L, OD D, ID d with no end preparation — the canonical pipe-body primitive (cross-section area A_p = π/4(D²−d²)).

items.name: Threaded Pipe End (Pin)
items.brief_description: External-thread pin end machined onto a pipe joint; tapered helical thread on OD with engaged thread length L and pitch p_t.

items.name: API Coupling Sleeve
items.brief_description: Short thick-wall internally-threaded sleeve (OD W, root-of-thread bore d1) that joins two pipe pins; parametrized for round, buttress, or extreme-line threads.

items.name: API Short Round Thread (STC)
items.brief_description: Symmetric V-form 8-tpi rounded thread cut on a short taper — short coupling form of the API round-thread connection.

items.name: API Long Round Thread (LTC)
items.brief_description: Same rounded V thread profile as STC but with a longer engaged thread length L for higher joint strength.

items.name: API Buttress Thread (BTC)
items.brief_description: Asymmetric trapezoidal 5-tpi thread with a near-radial load flank and angled stab flank — geometry parametrized by taper T, pitch p_t, and L.

items.name: Extreme-Line Trapezoidal Thread
items.brief_description: Integral (couplingless) trapezoidal thread with metal-to-metal seal, machined directly on upset pipe ends; critical section A_cr governs strength.

items.name: Extreme-Line Integral Connection
items.brief_description: Full integral pin-and-box connection without a separate coupling: upset pipe ends with trapezoidal thread plus metal-to-metal seal shoulders.

items.name: Proprietary Premium Connection
items.brief_description: Gas-tight premium pin/box with complex thread form, resilient seal ring, torque shoulder and metal-to-metal seal — parametrized envelope for VAM-class connections.

items.name: Metal-to-Metal Seal Land
items.brief_description: Smooth tapered/spherical sealing surface ahead of the threads where pin and box make a gas-tight contact at makeup.

items.name: Torque Shoulder
items.brief_description: Annular radial shoulder at the nose of a pin or behind a box that stops rotation at proper makeup and sets a defined contact stress.

items.name: Resilient Seal Ring Groove
items.brief_description: Internal annular groove in the coupling J-area that houses an elastomeric ring to back up the threads against leakage.

items.name: External Upset End
items.brief_description: Local OD increase forged onto pipe end (typical for tubing EUE and extreme-line casing) to provide material for thread cutting without losing wall.

items.name: Casing Shoe (Bottom Joint)
items.brief_description: Bottom-of-string joint with rounded/tapered nose used to guide casing into the hole and protect the bottom thread during running; parametrized nose radius + length.

items.name: Liner Hanger Body
items.brief_description: Mandrel with external slip pockets and cone that anchors the liner top inside a parent casing — cylindrical body with circumferential slip windows.

items.name: Casing Collar (Coupling Recess)
items.brief_description: External thick band at every joint where the coupling sits, used by collar locator tools — parametrized by OD bump height and band length.

items.name: Tubing Pup Joint
items.brief_description: Short (2–12 ft) externally threaded tubing section used for length adjustment; geometrically identical to a tubing joint but parametrized for short L.

items.name: Roller Cone (Tri-Cone) Drill Bit
items.brief_description: Three (sometimes two or four) rotating toothed cones mounted on journals beneath a pin-up body, with jet nozzles between cones.

items.name: PDC Fixed-Head Bit
items.brief_description: Single-piece matrix/steel crown with radial blades carrying PDC button cutters and a pin connection on top.

items.name: Slick Drill Collar
items.brief_description: Thick-wall heavy cylinder of constant OD with bore through center, pin on one end and box on the other.

items.name: Spiral Drill Collar
items.brief_description: Slick drill collar with helical grooves cut around the mid-body to relieve differential sticking.

items.name: Square Drill Collar
items.brief_description: Heavy collar with square cross-section and rounded, tungsten-carbide-coated corners for stiffness and wall support.

items.name: Pony Collar (Short Drill Collar)
items.brief_description: Short version of a standard drill collar (4–20 ft) used as a spacer between stabilizers in the BHA.

items.name: Hevi-Wate Drill Pipe
items.brief_description: Thick-wall drill pipe with extended tool joints and a center wear-pad (donut) upset midway along the tube.

items.name: Spiral-Wate Drill Pipe
items.brief_description: Hevi-Wate variant with helical grooves cut into the tube body in place of (or beside) the center wear pad.

items.name: Drill Pipe Joint
items.brief_description: Long thin-wall tube with a forged upset at each end welded to a thicker box tool joint and pin tool joint.

items.name: Drill Pipe Upset Transition (IU/EU/IEU)
items.brief_description: Localized ID/OD thickening between drill-pipe tube and tool joint; parametrized as internal, external, or both.

items.name: Tool Joint Box/Pin Connection
items.brief_description: Tapered threaded shoulder pair — external pin nose mating into internal box, sized by API NC/IF/FH numbered connection.

items.name: Hydraulic Drilling Jar
items.brief_description: Slim cylindrical body with a sliding mandrel/anvil section and external striking shoulder for delivering up/down impacts.

items.name: Integral Blade Stabilizer (IBS)
items.brief_description: One-piece mandrel with three spiraled raised blades forged integral to the body, blade OD near hole gauge.

items.name: Welded-Blade Stabilizer
items.brief_description: Mandrel with three straight or spiral blades welded onto its outside; geometry parametrized by blade twist and length.

items.name: Replaceable-Sleeve Stabilizer
items.brief_description: Mandrel with a threaded interchangeable sleeve carrying the three blades; sleeve unscrews for blade replacement.

items.name: Shrunk-On Sleeve Stabilizer
items.brief_description: Two-piece stabilizer where a heated bladed sleeve shrink-fits onto the mandrel body without threads.

items.name: DEI (Diamond Enhanced Insert) Stabilizer
items.brief_description: Integral spiral-blade stabilizer with rows of diamond-enhanced cylindrical inserts embedded in the blade leading edges.

items.name: Double Diamond Combo Tool
items.brief_description: Near-bit stabilizer with two axially stacked sets of three spiraled diamond-studded blades on a single mandrel.

items.name: Three-Point Roller Reamer
items.brief_description: Mandrel body with three pocket cutouts at 120° housing dumbbell-shaped rolling cutters at hole-gauge OD.

items.name: Six-Point Roller Reamer
items.brief_description: Reamer mandrel with two axial banks of three cutter pockets (six total) for higher wall contact up-string.

items.name: DEI Spiral-Body Reamer
items.brief_description: Solid spiral-bladed body with tapered ends and rows of diamond-enhanced inserts — no moving cutters.

items.name: DOG Sub (Near-Bit Diamond Sub)
items.brief_description: Short stout sub with longitudinal rows of knobby stud inserts wrapping the OD, threaded directly above the bit.

items.name: Reamer Roller Cutter (KSX/RSX/DEX)
items.brief_description: Dumbbell-shaped cutter: central inserted cylinder bounded by two larger flange wheels; insert pattern parametrized.

items.name: Mud Motor Power Section
items.brief_description: Long slim housing containing a helical lobed rotor inside an elastomer stator — parametrized by lobe count and stage length.

items.name: Bit Sub (Box × Box)
items.brief_description: Short adapter cylinder with internal threads (box) on both ends to connect a pin-up bit to a pin-up BHA component.

items.name: Crossover Sub (Box × Pin)
items.brief_description: Adapter with one box end and one pin end of differing thread profiles; may be straight or reduced-section.

items.name: Dual-OD Reduced-Section Sub
items.brief_description: Crossover sub with two distinct outside diameters — larger barrel toward one connection, stepped down toward the other.

items.name: Top Drive Saver Sub (Pin × Pin)
items.brief_description: Short double-pin sub with reduced OD that sacrifices itself between the top drive and the drill string.

items.name: Drill Pipe Body (Seamless Tube)
items.brief_description: Long thin-walled seamless cylinder forming the bulk of the drill pipe — parametrized by OD (D), wall thickness (t), inner diameter (d) and length; carries axial/torsional load between tool joints.

items.name: Internal Upset (IU) Pipe End
items.brief_description: Pipe end where the inner bore tapers down (wall thickens inward) over a short transition to match the tool joint root — OD stays at D, ID drops from d to dᵢᵤ with a ~18° internal cone.

items.name: External Upset (EU) Pipe End
items.brief_description: Pipe end whose outside diameter swells from D to a larger upset OD (ØW) via a ~35°±2° external cone, leaving the bore unchanged — provides material for the friction weld.

items.name: Internal-External Upset (IEU) Pipe End
items.brief_description: Combined upset that simultaneously expands the OD outward and thickens the wall inward at the pipe end, joining the body to the tool joint with both an external and internal transition cone.

items.name: 35° Upset Transition Cone
items.brief_description: Frustum forming the outer transition between pipe OD (D) and upset OD (ØW), with a half-angle of 35°±2° and a small fillet radius R at each end.

items.name: 18° Internal Upset Transition
items.brief_description: Internal frustum where the bore tapers from drill-pipe ID (d) up to upset ID (dᵢᵤ) at 18°±2°, used inside IU and IEU upsets to feather the wall thickness change.

items.name: Friction-Welded Joint Zone
items.brief_description: Short cylindrical section at upset OD where the pipe upset and tool joint are friction-welded together, typically modelled as a small flash/bead ring around the seam.

items.name: Tool Joint Pin (Male End)
items.brief_description: Externally threaded male half of the rotary-shouldered tool joint — a stepped cylinder with a tapered threaded nose, sealing shoulder face, and tong-grip body, parametrized by connection size.

items.name: Tool Joint Box (Female End)
items.brief_description: Internally threaded female half — an enlarged cylinder with an internal tapered threaded counterbore, mating shoulder face, and 18°±2° back-taper to the elevator upset.

items.name: Tool Joint Body Cylinder
items.brief_description: Heavy-wall plain cylindrical section of the tool joint (OD = ØW, ID = ØDᵢᵤ) between the elevator upset and the threaded end, providing wall mass for tongs and hardbanding.

items.name: Elevator Upset Shoulder (DE)
items.brief_description: Step-down ring on the tool joint OD where the diameter drops from ØW to ØDE at the weld neck — provides a square 90° lifting shoulder for the elevator.

items.name: 18° Box Back-Taper
items.brief_description: External 18°±2° conical taper at the rear of the box that blends the full tool-joint OD down to the elevator-upset OD, reducing stress concentration at the weld.

items.name: Box with 90° Square Shoulder
items.brief_description: Optional variant where the box back is a flat 90° shoulder instead of an 18° cone — a simple annular face perpendicular to the axis.

items.name: Hardbanding Wear Ring
items.brief_description: Raised circumferential weld-overlay band on the tool joint OD (ARNCO 100/150/300 XT, TCS 8000/Titanium) — a thin annular boss, typically 1–2 in wide and a few thousandths proud.

items.name: Tong Space Band
items.brief_description: Plain cylindrical zone (LPB on pin, LB on box) on the tool joint reserved for tong jaw bite — a parametric length of the unembellished tool-joint OD.

items.name: NC Numbered Rotary Connection
items.brief_description: API V-038R rotary-shouldered thread on a tapered pin/box pair, parametrized by NC size (NC26, 31, 38, 40, 46, 50) which sets pitch diameter, taper, and thread count.

items.name: Internal Flush (IF) Connection
items.brief_description: Rotary connection whose pin ID matches the drill-pipe bore so the joined string is hydraulically flush — geometry is a tapered threaded pin/box with no internal step.

items.name: Full Hole (FH) Connection
items.brief_description: Rotary connection sized for a larger through-bore than IF (smaller wall, bigger ID), parametrized like NC but with the FH proportions; geometry: tapered threads + flush bore.

items.name: Pin Nose Lead-In Chamfer
items.brief_description: Small conical chamfer at the very tip of the pin (ahead of the first full thread) that protects the lead thread during stab-in — a short truncated cone on the pin nose.

items.name: Box Counterbore at Shoulder
items.brief_description: Smooth cylindrical counterbore just inside the box face, ahead of the first thread, providing pin nose clearance and the make-up shoulder land — an annular pocket of depth a few threads.

items.name: Complete Drill Pipe Joint Assembly
items.brief_description: Full Range-1/2/3 joint = box tool joint + weld + upset + body + upset + weld + pin tool joint — the canonical multi-feature assembly the rest of the catalog parametrizes.

items.name: Internal Coating Film
items.brief_description: Thin uniform-thickness film bonded to the entire bore (Tuboscope TCS) providing corrosion barrier and lower hydraulic friction — modelled as an offset inner surface a few mils thick.

items.name: Die-Stamped Marking Panel
items.brief_description: Rectangular flat or shallow-engraved patch on the tool joint OD carrying logo, drawing no., heat code, and connection type — geometric shape is a small embossed/recessed planar zone.

items.name: Thread Relief Groove
items.brief_description: Narrow annular groove between the last engaged thread and the make-up shoulder on both pin and box, allowing the shoulders to seat without thread interference.
